messages:
sam: Heads-up — starting intake for Catalyst-XXL (70B variant) for Redwood catalog. Need checklist for quant experiments, perf baselines, and an announcement timeline.
elaine: :wave: adding initial asks — perf bench, eval set mapping to existing prompts, and regression smoke tests. do we have a target latency/cost envelope?
qadir: Target SLOs: p99 < 2800ms on A100s for 1k tokens, and cost per 1k tokens <= current Llama-2-70B-quant profile. If we can't hit that, we fallback to 32-bit or a smaller variant.
lina: For onboarding docs: need model card, license check, input/output schema, function-calling compatibility notes, and quant recipes. I'll draft model catalog entry template.
sam: Thumbs up. Also need deploy plan: canary with 5% traffic, metric gating on quality/regressions. Who owns rollout notes and announcement?
elaine: I'll own announcement copy and console route creation. qadir can own quant/bench triage. sam will coordinate release window with eng-oncall.
ml-ci-bot: auto-run: catalyst-xxl/base fp32 smoke tests queued (CI-1129). Expected run ~30m.
qadir: Quick sketch of quant experiments: 4-bit PTQ w/ GPTQ, FP16->NF4 post-quant calibration on 2k prompt shards, KV-cache validation. We'll measure perplexity and a small human-eval suite.
lina: Catalog draft fields: name, size, family, license, recommended config (batch, seq_len, beam), quant flags, known regressions. I'll post PR to model-catalog repo after we confirm license.
sam: Can we attach a minimal checklist here? I'll paste a short one:
```
- Legal & license sign-off
- Model artifact integrity (sha256)
- Eval corpus mapping + baseline scores
- Quant experiment matrix (4b/5b/8b, per-layer config)
- Perf runs (latency/cost) across hosts
- Canary rollout plan & metric gates
- Release note + announcement draft
- Post-rollout watch schedule (oncall)
```
elaine: Nice. For metric gates let's use: quality delta <= 1% on rouge/accuracy vs baseline, latency regression <= 20% p95, error-rate < 0.5%. If gates fail, auto-fallback to previous model.
qadir: I'll add additional QA: response-truncation checks, numerical precision tests, and hallucination regression on 200 prompt pairs.
ml-ci-bot: result: fp32 smoke tests passed (CI-1129) — logs: https://ci.internal/runs/1129
ops-bot: Deploy window request queued for 2026-05-04 22:00 UTC. Please ack or propose alternate.
sam: Ack for that window. Elaine, can you do announcement draft by 2026-04-28 so marketing can review?
elaine: Yep. Draft will include: model overview, recommended configs, expected cost delta vs existing 70B, and known caveats about 4-bit variants.
lina: One more thing — console observability: add per-route token cost and per-request quality sampling. We'll need a sampling hook from evaluator to Console.
qadir: I'm going to run quick perf sweep on a smaller seq len (256/512/1024) to get scaling curves. Will share numbers by EOD tomorrow.
sam: Perfect. After perf + quant numbers we decide whether to publish model-catalog entry as "beta" or "verified". Recommend beta initially.
elaine: Announcement channel list: #general, product-announcements, and a short note to SOC for compliance.
ml-ci-bot: queued eval-run: catalyst-xxl/quant-matrix (ID 2207). Results ETA ~4h.
qadir: FYI, if 4-bit causes hallucination spike we'll try hybrid strategy: kv-cache layer in fp16, attention in 4-bit. Has worked before.
lina: I'll include known mitigation steps in catalog entry so customers know fallback knobs.
sam: Thanks all. Action items: qadir -> quant/perf numbers; lina -> catalog PR; elaine -> announcement draft; sam -> confirm deploy window with eng-oncall and add rollout policy to Console. We'll reconvene after CI eval results. :thumbsup:
